items.title: Gold 2027 Number Balloons
items.alt: Four gold foil balloons spelling 2027, each tied with a teal bow, with a round navy balloon behind the final seven.
items.description: Crimped foil edges and curled gold ribbons give the clear number row a festive dimensional finish.

items.title: Happy New Year 2027 with a Midnight Clock
items.alt: Gold-and-navy Happy New Year 2027 lettering beneath a round Roman-numeral clock with both hands pointing to twelve.
items.description: Gold leafy sprigs flank the dark blue clock above a sweeping navy ribbon under the large year.

items.title: Welcome 2027 Party Popper
items.alt: Bright Welcome 2027 lettering bursting from a striped party popper with curled ribbons, stars and small confetti shapes.
items.description: The multicolored message sits diagonally across the fan of streamers above the red-and-gold cone.

items.title: Hello 2027 with Colorful Fireworks
items.alt: Teal Hello lettering above coral 2027 numerals, crowned by three colorful star-centered firework bursts.
items.description: Gold outlines and small stars connect the pink, teal and purple bursts around the greeting.

items.title: Cheers to 2027 Toast
items.alt: Two gold-filled champagne flutes touching above navy-and-gold Cheers to 2027 lettering and a curling gold ribbon.
items.description: The slender glass stems frame the word Cheers while the large year anchors the bottom of the greeting.

items.title: 2027 Toy Blocks with a Star
items.alt: Four colorful toy blocks arranged as 20 above 27, beside a smiling yellow star character waving one hand.
items.description: The blue, red, green and yellow blocks form a compact square, with large contrasting numerals for easy reading.
